summary: E2E regression for SCALE+ removal + new event-detail/registration/payment/scholarship/inline-edit flows. Backend pytest: 17/18 PASSED (94%) — only failure is GET /api/payments/status/{session_id} returning 500 because Stripe says 'No such checkout.session' immediately after a session is successfully created. Frontend: all critical flows verified — homepage has no SCALE+, hero CTAs ('Explore Events'/'Our Story') exist with correct testids, event cards have event-details-btn-{id}, EventDetailPage has all reg-* testids and submits successfully (returns Complete Payment CTA), PaymentPage initiates Stripe checkout and redirects to checkout.stripe.com, EventScholarshipPage submits successfully, admin login → /admin, inline edit toggle (nav-edit-mode-toggle) present for admin and clicking hero-headline opens inline editor with 2 editable controls.

critical.issue: Returns 500 immediately after a successful create-session. Stripe API: 'No such checkout.session: cs_test_...' surfaced as CheckoutError from emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout.get_checkout_status. Reproduced via curl + pytest. Breaks /payment-success polling flow on frontend (console error visible). Likely a key/account mismatch or session-fetch bug in the integration's get_checkout_status path; same sk_test_emergent key creates the session but cannot fetch it.

integration_issues.issue: PaymentSuccessPage will receive 500 from /api/payments/status/{session_id} (see backend issue above) — user will see error/stuck state after returning from Stripe. Not directly tested end-to-end (Stripe is external) but root-cause confirmed via direct API call.

issues: Logo image renders large/uncropped on hero — visual polish only, no functional impact.

action_items: Fix GET /api/payments/status/{session_id} 500 — Stripe 'No such checkout.session'. Check whether the StripeCheckout instance in get_payment_status is using a different api_key/account vs create_checkout_session, or whether the session is being filtered by mode/account. Until this is fixed, /payment-success will not reflect paid status and the registration won't be marked paid.

get_payment_status creates a brand-new StripeCheckout instance every request — fine for correctness but inefficient. Consider caching at app state.

create_checkout_session and get_checkout_status both reach into emergentintegrations with the same api_key + webhook_url; if these need to match the original session's account, that's a third-party integration concern — needs investigation.

rca of the issue: Stripe session lookup failure — RCA: After /api/payments/create-session creates a checkout session and returns a real cs_test_... session_id and a working https://checkout.stripe.com/... URL, immediately calling /api/payments/status/{session_id} fails with stripe._error.InvalidRequestError 'No such checkout.session'. Both endpoints construct StripeCheckout the same way (api_key=sk_test_emergent, webhook_url=...). Reproduction: POST registration, POST create-session, immediately GET /api/payments/status/{session_id} → 500. Mitigation: investigate emergentintegrations StripeCheckout.get_checkout_status — possible causes: (a) different Stripe account routing between create vs retrieve, (b) session being created in connected account vs retrieved on platform account, (c) an environment-specific shim. As a workaround the frontend should not fail hard if /payments/status returns 500 — show a 'we will email you confirmation' state instead.
